paragraphs.text: 据摘要，Fontes（1985）把曲白蚁属的旧组合 Curvitermes planioculus Mathews, 1977 处理为小型曲白蚁（Curvitermes minor）的次异名。
paragraphs.text_en: According to the abstract, Fontes (1985) treated the former combination Curvitermes planioculus Mathews, 1977 as a junior synonym of Curvitermes minor.
paragraphs.text_es: Según el resumen, Fontes (1985) trató la combinación antigua Curvitermes planioculus Mathews, 1977 como sinónimo posterior de Curvitermes minor.

references.citation: Fontes, L. R. 1985. New genera and new species of Nasutitermitinae from the Neotropical Region (Isoptera, Termitidae). Revista Brasileira de Zoologia.
